name: SD: A vaccination clinic's doses (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A vaccination clinic's waiting list, patients vaccinated and awaiting their follow-up, doses in the fridge and expired doses awaiting disposal, counted every day. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-clinic-doses/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests co-flows on a stock that also drains: every vaccination, of a booked patient or of a walk-in who comes straight in from outside, uses a dose, and doses also expire. Doses come once a week, so in a busy or short week they run out and the waiting list grows. When a second nurse joins and leaves is announced as an era.
